BriefDescription: Clock cycles while this event is selected
Instructions retired
Load landings: a plain or FP load's data written back, fast or slow path or forwarded (a wrong-path or replayed landing included; AMO and LR not)
Stores the store queue hands to the LSU after commit (AMO, SC and CBO writes not)
Pipeline restarts: a squash at the ROB head, or a mispredict's release (decode resteers not)
D$ requests taken: a read at its door (loads and page-table-walk reads) or a write into its store queue
D$ line fills started (an MSHR allocated) by a load, store, cbo.zero or page-table-walk read; a join of a fill in flight not
I$ requests taken, one 16-byte pair each (run-ahead and wrong-path ones included)
I$ requests whose lookup misses the virtual tag (a physical-tag reconcile, a prefetch-buffer hit or an L2 fill follows)
M holds an unfinished AMO, LR, SC or CBO, + no lane issued while a scheduler's lowest-slot waiting entry needs an integer load's, AMO's or CSR read's result
The MD stage holds a divide (occupancy)
A multiply in flight in a lane (occupancy)
Stage F holds an op it cannot advance, + no lane issued while a scheduler's lowest-slot waiting entry needs an FP op's, FP load's, FP-port or divide result
The queue head waits for a credit other than the ROB's while M can advance and no load or FP dependency holds issue: ST_IQ + ST_RN + ST_SQ + ST_LQ + ST_SRZ
The queue head waits for ROB room
The queue head: its lane's scheduler, the FP FIFO and scheduler, the head-op register or the divide credit is full
The queue head: a rename shard is below LOWAT, or the map's sweep after a squash runs
The queue head holds a store and has no store-queue credit (none while a head op is in flight or in the IR)
The queue head holds a load and has no load-queue credit (none while a head op is in flight or in the IR)
The queue head: a serializing op drains or is in flight, a CSR op waits for the one before it, or a CBO waits for older addresses (the rest of ST_DSP)
The IR is empty, the queue head waits for no credit, M is free, no redirect is live and no back-end refill is due: FE_MMU + FE_IC + FE_ALN + FE_QUE
FE_BUB while the iMMU cannot translate the fetch address (a second-level lookup, a walk, or a walk held behind a weak branch)
FE_BUB while the fetch window is empty
FE_BUB while fetch has bytes but no complete instruction
FE_BUB while fetch has an instruction that has not reached the IR (queue latency or a dispatch freeze)
Redirect: conditional branch mispredict
Redirect: indirect jump (jalr) target
Redirect: an exception, an interrupt, a dispatch-time or queue-entry fault, or a memory-ordering replay (xRET, sfence.vma, CSR-write redirects and fence.i not)
A mispredict's restart: from its resolve to its release or its squash at the ROB head
dMMU walker busy (cycles): a second-level lookup or a walk, for a queued load or store or for M's head op
dMMU walker starts: a request the 64-entry first level does not hold (a second-level lookup, and a walk when that misses)
The LQ has a ready candidate the LSU port does not take (a store has the port, the FSM is busy, the D$ read door is full, or its tag's response is due)
Load reads in flight at the D$, summed per cycle (fast-path tags awaiting their response, and the FSM's load): / MEM_LDSENT is the mean load-read latency
The LSU presents a write (a store, an AMO's write, a CBO) that the D$ store queue has no room for and no device acknowledges
An LQ candidate is alias-blocked while a blocked load with its wait bit set waits on an older store whose address is unknown
An LQ candidate is alias-blocked and no blocked load waits on an unknown older address (a known older store overlaps)
Loads the port takes while an older store, committed or not, is live in the store queue (count)
Loads whose landing is dropped because a kill arrived while their access ran, fast or slow path (count)
No LQ candidate is ready and an unblocked device load waits to be the ROB head
load-queue occupancy, summed per cycle
store-queue occupancy, summed per cycle
top-down: bad speculation (a redirect, or a resolved restart waiting)
top-down: back-end (M held, the queue head without a credit, a frozen IR, or the refill cycle after one)
top-down: back-end waiting on memory (td_k 10 or 13: M on a head op, or a dependency on an integer load, AMO or CSR read)
top-down: back-end, no ROB room (td_k 12)
top-down: back-end, no scheduler, store-queue or load-queue credit (td_k 15, 17, 18)
top-down: front-end latency (td_k 5, 6: iMMU, or no fetch bytes)
top-down: front-end (FE_BUB outside bad speculation)
Instructions dispatched (0..IW per cycle)
Load reads sent to the D$ (count: a fast-path tag issued, or the FSM starting a load)
top-down cause td_k = 0: dispatched 1 (ok:1)
top-down cause td_k = 1: dispatched 2 (ok:2)
top-down cause td_k = 2: dispatched 3 (ok:3)
top-down cause td_k = 3: bad speculation: a redirect (bs:redirect)
top-down cause td_k = 4: bad speculation: a resolved restart waiting (bs:drain)
top-down cause td_k = 5: front-end: the iMMU (fe:immu)
top-down cause td_k = 6: front-end: no fetch bytes (fe:icache)
top-down cause td_k = 7: front-end: bytes but no whole instruction (fe:align)
top-down cause td_k = 8: front-end: an instruction not yet in the IR (fe:queue)
top-down cause td_k = 9: front-end: any other (fe:other)
top-down cause td_k = 10: back-end: M holds a head op (be:M-mem)
top-down cause td_k = 11: back-end: M holds a non-memory op (be:M-other)
top-down cause td_k = 12: back-end: no ROB room (be:rob-full)
top-down cause td_k = 13: back-end: issue waits on an integer load, AMO or CSR read (be:dep-load)
top-down cause td_k = 14: back-end: issue waits on an FP, FP-load, FP-port or divide result (be:dep-fp)
top-down cause td_k = 15: back-end: no scheduler credit at the queue head (be:iq-full)
top-down cause td_k = 16: back-end: a rename shard below LOWAT, or the map's sweep (be:rename)
top-down cause td_k = 17: back-end: no store-queue credit (be:sq-full)
top-down cause td_k = 18: back-end: no load-queue credit (be:lq-full)
top-down cause td_k = 19: back-end: serialisation, a CSR op or a CBO waiting (be:serialize)
top-down cause td_k = 20: back-end: the IR held otherwise (be:held)
top-down cause td_k = 21: dispatched 0: the take squashed (ok:0)
top-down cause td_k = 22: dispatched 4 (ok:4)
